I checked this with cluster-bot, CMO is still not degraded with `nodeSelector: {foo: bar}`. Maybe I should wait for more time?
```
% oc get pod -n openshift-monitoring | grep Pending
prometheus-k8s-1                                         0/6     Pending   0          21m
% oc get co/monitoring
NAME         VERSION                                                AVAILABLE   PROGRESSING   DEGRADED   SINCE   MESSAGE
monitoring   4.22.0-0-2026-03-25-085003-test-ci-ln-ldmwym2-latest   True        False         False      57m
```

@Tai-RedHat can you check the CMO logs? In my experience, it can take up to 20 minutes but the logs should show that the PrometheusK8s task fails. You can also check the status of the Prometheus resource (e.g. `oc get prometheus k8s`).

The operator is degraded after 20mins+, then I reverted the configmap. Everything was back to normal after a few minutes.
```
% oc get co/monitoring
NAME         VERSION                                                AVAILABLE   PROGRESSING   DEGRADED   SINCE   MESSAGE
monitoring   4.22.0-0-2026-03-25-085003-test-ci-ln-ldmwym2-latest   True        False         False      2m28s
```
/verified by @Tai-RedHat
